rationale: PBR.A has gapped down ~17.5% on fundamental policy concerns (dividend cuts, price controls, forced capex), creating a highly uncertain environment where the stock is mid-range after bouncing off the session low of $18.77. The last five 1-minute candles show a steady drift lower from $19.66 to $19.57 with no clear reversal structure, and the news-driven catalyst introduces regime uncertainty that makes both long (catching a falling knife) and short (chasing after a massive gap) unattractive risk/reward propositions at this moment. With an existing working long in NU already committed, adding exposure to a politically-driven crash in a correlated EM name increases portfolio risk without a clean mechanical setup.
